config.preprocessing: Strip outer whitespace only; retain generated content; omit metadata, system prompts, injected profiles and transcript history. No summaries, translation or message concatenation.
config.round_rule: Round t starts with generated simulator message t, including generated initial inspection requests in review workflows. The next visible actor handoff/question/final specification before the next simulator message is its response. The fixed SciConv input question and pre-first-simulator-reply actor question are excluded. Terminal simulator messages without actor replies remain simulator observations only.
config.availability_rule: Only original coordinator-finished traces; every configured rollout must have a nonempty role message at t across all five settings. Use this common T_q for all ten persona pairs within each question and role. No truncation to 3–4 rounds, padding, imputation or carry-forward.
config.weighting: Equal questions; equal eligible rounds within each question. Source-stratified whole-question bootstrap with original source counts fixed.
config.case_rule: First two source benchmarks in frozen priority order with a jointly eligible question having >=2 observed rounds for each displayed persona and role at rollout 1. Within each source choose nearest median question-level separation averaged equally over roles and ten pairs; lexicographic question ID breaks ties. No outcome scores or visual inspection in selection.
config.pca: Separate full-SVD 2D PCA for each question and role, fit to all available nonempty original messages from all configured personas/rollouts/rounds for that question and role. Unweighted messages; no whitening. Project fixed rollout 1 only. Local coordinates are not comparable between plots.
